issue.author: mhernandez
issue.title: Checkout button does nothing on Safari 17
issue.body: Clicking "Pay now" on Safari 17.4 (macOS) does nothing. No network request fires. Chrome and Firefox work. Console shows `TypeError: structuredClone is not a function`.

decision.reasoning: A client-side JavaScript error prevents users from completing checkout on Safari 17, directly impacting revenue for that browser share.

Make private: no
Why: A client-side JavaScript error prevents users from completing checkout on Safari 17, directly impacting revenue for that browser share.

issue.author: dpatel
issue.title: Customers charged twice when they double-click Pay
issue.body: We had 14 duplicate charges yesterday. Looks like a double-click on Pay sends two payment intents. Refunding manually. This is costing us real money.

decision.reasoning: This is an active bug causing duplicate charges and direct financial loss to customers and the business, making it a revenue emergency. Idempotency and payment intent double-submission should be addressed immediately by the payments team.

issue.author: lin-yu
issue.title: Add Apple Pay support
issue.body: Our mobile conversion would go up a lot with Apple Pay. Stripe supports it — any plans?

decision.reasoning: This is a feature request to add Apple Pay as a payment method for better mobile conversion. It belongs to the payments team and is a standard priority feature.
